faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III posts is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support III position at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a three-year graduate degree in a relevant field or a PG degree in a relevant field with specific experience as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month, plus HRA (20%).

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official AIIMS Nagpur website.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Nagpur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 441108.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is AIIMS/NGP/DCM/Rec/2026/PTS-03.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Technical Support III post is contractual.
